description: Fetch at most one next published reply and the read status of one visitor message (sent_message_id, default latest). Never returns full history or visitor text. Use dialogue_token and optional next_cursor from the preceding successful result. Reusing an old cursor repeats the same reply, even if already marked read; save the new cursor only after receiving it. A returned reply is marked read by this client. message=null still includes sent_message read status. Reads never mean acceptance or change the next actor.

dialogue_token.description: Secret bearer token returned once on creation. Keep private; never place in URLs, shared memory or logs.

name: get_dialogue
title: Receive one reply
